_note: Reviewed in-place revisions of migrations that were already applied somewhere other than production. Listing a file here does NOT make migrate.mjs accept it automatically; it only permits an operator to run --reconcile with the checksum recorded in their database and a reason. Once a migration has been applied to a shared test project, it is frozen: further changes go into a new migration and are never added here.

0000_compat_bootstrap.sql.why: the original migration attempted to grant privileges on Supabase-owned auth, which a project database role cannot do. The revision creates local auth objects only when the schema is absent.
priorRevisions: unconditional auth schema grant and local auth.users create

0011_apply_integrity_and_legacy_compat.s.why: edited after it had been applied to local test databases: default_workspace_id() used min(uuid), which does not exist; and two 'compatibility views' that never worked were removed. Never applied to production.
priorRevisions: default_workspace_id() calling min(id) on a uuid column
